description: Paywall catalog and the learning-profile goal (AI-19, #301). Prices and discounts are configuration (learning.plans.*), not a tariff contract; no payment is possible yet (#79).

response.current: {plan FREE|PLUS|PRO|MAX, period MONTH|YEAR, validUntil RFC 3339 UTC, autoRenew false, source CONFIG|BILLING|PROMO}
response.plans: [{plan, availability AVAILABLE|TEASER (MAX only when learning.plans.max-teaser.enabled, never purchasable), priceRub {month, year = month×12×(100−discount)/100 half-up}, perDayRub = month/30 rounded, yearDiscountPercent, highlights[3] (human units from allowances-v1), allowances {materialsPerMonth {min,max}, voiceMinutesPerMonth|null, voiceMinutesPerDay, answerChecksPerMonth, answerChecksPerDay, podcastsPerMonth, qualityImagesPerMonth, factChecksPerMonth, smartPlans {limit, window WEEK|MONTH}}, recommendedFor [goal]}] ordered FREE, PLUS, PRO, MAX
response.experiments: {experimentKey: variant}; at most 20 enabled server-owned assignments, empty object when none; key [a-z][a-z0-9_]{1,39}, variant [a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,31}; the 21st enabled experiment is rejected at startup
response.pendingDiscount: null or {percent integer 1..90, plan PLUS|PRO|null, validUntil RFC 3339 UTC}; a promo discount changes no entitlement and awaits future billing (#79)
response.checkout: AVAILABLE|UNAVAILABLE: whether this account may start a payment now (learning.billing.checkout mode, tester list and a configured terminal; contracts/billing); UNAVAILABLE when billing is off or not deployed

notes: No query parameter or header changes anything; POST/PUT are 405.
Current PROMO access reports period MONTH, the quota cadence, regardless of the gift duration; it is not an annual billing purchase. All plans grant monthly allowances, including annual BILLING.
Recommendations by goal (config): EXAMS → PRO, INTERVIEW → PLUS, LANGUAGE → PLUS, WORK → PRO, SELF → PLUS; no goal → none (neutral).

endpoints.response: {goal EXAMS|INTERVIEW|LANGUAGE|WORK|SELF|null, skipped boolean, answeredAt RFC 3339|null}; unanswered is {null, false, null}

endpoints.request: exactly {"goal": "EXAMS|INTERVIEW|LANGUAGE|WORK|SELF"} or {"goal": null, "skipped": true}; body ≤256 bytes; anything else 400 INVALID_REQUEST
notes: The goal changes only copy (the /plans heading, the composer placeholder, empty states) and the recommendation; it never reaches an AI provider.
